scope: Public synthetic development. Three matched evaluation replicas of the same cumulative checkpoint. No protected source, operational readout publication, new controller or acceptance.
hypothesis: A trial readout selected with independent historical and prospective checks retains old forecasting ability and remains competitive on altered causal structures.
stage_rule: Select the prospective readout only if historical consumed and disjoint fresh familiar validation losses stay within the cap for each target, and disjoint new validation mean Brier improves by the margin against the previous selected readout. Other trials continue the same developing native and four-head prospect, preserving all actual receipts.
controls: Pinned native; continuously growing native; full, trailing32 and change-point32 conditional Beta predictors fit from all the same authenticated prefix and new outcomes. Fixed identical public interventions and disjoint validator-only holdouts. No arm receives source law, seed, mask, mapping or held outcomes for learning.
classification: On every independent seed and both altered structures, cold replay, separate historical report limits, 0.005 advantage over strongest fixed/fitted comparator and 0.005 noninferiority to unguarded native are required. Accuracy and whole-process cost are descriptive for this stage. Return-stage and per-action prequential results are additional diagnostics.
stop: One frozen run. Record failures without repeated scoring, altered thresholds, or new seeds after seeing scores. Protected first-use and independently accepted science are excluded.
